claim_boundary: frozen low-capacity held-out transfer probe only; no causal, routing, utility, learning, adaptation, calibrated-belief, or general capability claim without manual review
checkpoint: post-transition final delay frame; no resolution frame is supplied to Demian
schedule_control_semantics: [history_length, reliability_1, ..., reliability_8], padded with 0.0 and containing no evidence symbols
fit_scope: per model seed and delay: fit only on all six-event train-family rows; reuse identical coefficients, standardization, and fixed label-independent projection for every held-out family
conditional_shuffle: permute training targets within (history length, sorted reliability multiset, final evidence symbol, final evidence reliability) groups
independent_unit: model seed; projection dimensions and projection seeds are fixed sensitivity conditions, not independent replications
acceptance_criterion: for each delay and each held-out family, a model seed must exceed every matched control in projected full-state R2; report seed-wise margins and their median without status promotion
falsifier: projected full-state does not exceed every matched control at the model-seed unit across either held-out family, or only succeeds at a selected projection condition
